children: Liquidity Services reported record fiscal 2026 GMV of $1.645 billion and 30% growth in Adjusted EBITDA to $79.1 million.
Fiscal 2026 GMV rose 5%; net income grew 33% to $37.3 million, and operating cash flow was $58 million.
Q4 Adjusted EBITDA increased 20% to $22.3 million and net income rose 52% to $11.9 million, despite revenue declining 10% to $106.4 million.
The $80 million cash acquisition of Invaluable expands the company into fine art, antiques, jewelry and collectibles; management expects it to be accretive to adjusted earnings in fiscal 2027.
Elevated retail inventory is expected to temporarily weigh on recovery levels and Q1 retail GMV and revenue; management expects conditions to normalize over the next few quarters.
Fiscal Q1 2027 guidance: GMV of $580 million–$640 million, Adjusted EBITDA of $19 million–$22 million and GAAP net income of $8 million–$11 million.
